content.thinking: Scaling bad: maybe 4096/8192/262k ~ minutes (5.4s at 50k, edges factor5.2, nodes4, maybe ~30-60s). Could be okay under360s. But networkx DiGraph memory and construction maybe. Let's benchmark bigger maybe 2000/4000/130k.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && timeout 300 python3 - <<'EOF'
import sys,time,random
sys.path.insert(0,'deps')
import networkx as nx
random.seed(2)
R,O,E = 4096,8192,262144
G=nx.DiGraph()
S=-1;T=-2
G.add_node(S,demand=-R); G.add_node(T,demand=R)
for i in range(R): G.add_edge(S,i,capacity=1,weight=0)
for j in range(O): G.add_edge(R+j,T,capacity=3,weight=0)
for k in range(E):
    i=random.randrange(R);j=random.randrange(O)
    G.add_edge(i,R+j,capacity=1,weight=random.randrange(10**9))
print('built',G.number_of_nodes(),G.number_of_edges())
t=time.time(); cost,flow=nx.network_simplex(G); print('done',time.time()-t,cost)
EOF
